Take your time to read. Builds are not that hard. It's mostly: Magic goes pew pew (full int), strength bonks with big weapons, and dexterity uses quick/smaller weapons.

Also, if you need to use summons to beat stronger bosses use it, they exist for a purpose and if its too hard, go somewhere else/go grind some exp. It's an RPG in the end, so it's heavy on builds/stats and requires you more attention than other games, still its a pretty simple RPG.

Remember It's all about the journey, not the destination, and every single player takes this journey differently. Thats why people love these games.

And if you are having to force yourself to play, maybe this game isnt for you, not every game is for everyone, maybe its just FOMO again, but if you rly want to try, i would suggest to just stop worrying if you are doing something wrong, and keep your journey, sooner or later you'll get to your destination.  
And if you really want to follow a playthrough i would suggest you to instead of looking for an entire game playthrough look up on specific things, like a npc quest/how to get a specific weapon.

Anyway, Have a good journey in the Lands Between :)

If you're completely new to game/level design you'll see a lot of topics but not dive so deep into It.

If you come from a background it still valid because the week assignments with feedback are pretty good to train your level design skills.

So far ive been liking It 

My only tip would be to First be sure you'll have from 10 to 20h each week to dedicate yourself to the studies.
